name: com.tencent.tinker.lib.service.DefaultTinkerResultService
description: Tencent Tinker and Tencent Cloud Micro Tinker use this service to handle completed hot-fix patches. On success it removes temporary patch files and restarts the app when a new patch version needs to take effect.
disableEffect: A completed patch may not be finalized or activated, leaving an app fix unavailable.
